newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Spot Saudi riyal flat, interbank rates steady.
newsitem.headline: Spot Saudi riyal flat, interbank rates steady.

text.p: The spot Saudi riyal was steady against the dollar this week and riyal interbank deposit rates were barely changed in moderate trade, dealers said.
The spot riyal was stable at 3.7504/06 to the dollar.
Dealers said some deposits lost 1/16 point amid good liquidity. Spot-next and one-week deposits were quoted at 5-1/2, 3/8 percent.

One-month funds were steady at 5-1/2, 3/8 percent and three months were at 5-11/16, 9/16 percent. Six month and one-year deposits dropped 1/16 point to 5-13/16, 11/16 percent and 6-1/16, 5-15/16 percent respectively.
